channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Philippine House Approves Bill to Restrict Minors' Social Media Access
item.description: The lower house of the Philippines' Congress has approved a bill aimed at restricting minors' access to social media. The legislation seeks to regulate the use of these platforms by individuals under the age of 18. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: France Faces New Student Protests Amid Political Strife
item.description: France is preparing for a new wave of nationwide student demonstrations. Reports indicate that transnational political actors and far-left networks are leveraging the ongoing student unrest. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: GOP Ad Buyer Misfires, Spends $25,000 in Wrong Portland
item.description: Allies of Maine Senator Susan Collins mistakenly spent $25,000 on an advertisement targeting her rival in Portland, Oregon, instead of Portland, Maine. The ad buyer confused the two cities, leading to the misdirected expenditure. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
